sec: sec:B010: Promote secure patterns in generated code / Control mays

blocks.id: blk:B010: Promote secure patterns in generated code / Control mays/1
blocks.text: Implementing safeguards to promote secure defaults for session management in generated code. For example, applying HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite flags to session cookies by default, or defaulting to CSRF protections on state-changing endpoints.

sentences.text: Implementing safeguards to promote secure defaults for session management in generated code.
For example, applying HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite flags to session cookies by default, or defaulting to CSRF protections on state-changing endpoints.

blocks.id: blk:B010: Promote secure patterns in generated code / Control mays/2
blocks.text: Implementing safeguards to promote defensive programming patterns in generated code. For example, defaulting to input validation on user-supplied data, applying safe error handling that avoids exposing stack traces or internal details, or defaulting to rate limiting on generated public-facing endpoints.

sentences.text: Implementing safeguards to promote defensive programming patterns in generated code.

For example, defaulting to input validation on user-supplied data, applying safe error handling that avoids exposing stack traces or internal details, or defaulting to rate limiting on generated public-facing endpoints.

blocks.id: blk:B010: Promote secure patterns in generated code / Control mays/3
blocks.text: Implementing safeguards to prevent generated logging code from capturing secrets or personal information. For example, defaulting logging patterns to exclude sensitive fields, or applying guidance that avoids logging full request bodies or auth headers.
